user.title: Connect to IR/RF Command Hub
user.description: Open the IR/RF Command Hub App's Settings page in Home Assistant and copy the pairing code shown there.

error.invalid_code: That doesn't look like a valid pairing code. Copy it again from the App's Settings page.
error.invalid_auth: The App rejected this pairing code. It may have been regenerated -- copy a fresh one.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the App. Make sure it's running and try again.
